title: A Tensor Critical Threshold in Cubic Spherical Kernel Graphs
summary: We identify a strong-detection transition within the critical scale for testing cubic spherical kernel graphs against $G(n,1/2)$. Let $X_1,\ldots,X_n$ be independent uniform points on $\mathbb S^{d-1}$. Conditional on these points, edges are independent, with connection probability \[ \frac{1+βZ_{3,d}(\langle X_i,X_j\rangle)}{2}. \] Here $Z_{3,d}$ is the normalized cubic zonal harmonic, with multiplicity $N_{3,d}\sim d^3/6$.
